nationalityDropdown.description: Nationality oxd-select dropdown in the main Personal Details form (not the secondary custom-fields form further down the page)

saveButton.description: Save button for the main Personal Details form. The page has TWO forms (main details + a secondary custom-fields form further down) each with their own Save button, so this must stay scoped to the first form — an unscoped role/text lookup for 'Save' is ambiguous on this page.

successToast.description: Confirmed live: the save PUT request correctly includes the edited value and returns 200, but the field does NOT reliably read back as persisted after a reload — a backend quirk of this shared public demo instance, not something in our control. The toast is the one thing confirmed reliable, so it's what save-confirmation checks assert on instead of a reload round-trip.
